title: Player Falls Indefinitely Through Boundary Hole Without Void Death
explanation: At frame 3471 (t=58.27s), the player fell past OUT_OF_BOUNDS_Y (1400.0) at (17894.93, 1403.4) and continued falling down into the void to Y=245423.75 without triggering player death or respawn. Traced to Player.gd:L244-L256 where exceeding OUT_OF_BOUNDS_Y logs an anomaly but never calls die().
repro_hint: Fall through the boundary hole near the level terminus; the player falls infinitely into the void without dying.
